title: How the dog’s day went
description: A handful of episodes with sound and video instead of a long feed of notifications.

blocks.text: Dozens of messages about barking do not explain what was happening in between. The owner has to open the recordings one by one.

quote.text: my biggest complaint is how the "noisy / resting" feature. If my dog barks for 10 minutes, it won't say "Dog was noisy for 10 minutes." Instead, I will have separate times for each bark.

blocks.text: Group neighboring events into stretches with a duration and a short preview. Comparing days helps pick the recordings to discuss with a trainer.
The summary describes the episodes that were recorded. It does not establish the reason for the behavior from a single sound.
